simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִבְחוֹר (H4004) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: מִבְחוֹר (mibchôwr) means select , i.e. well fortified First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 3 19.

definitions.full: H4004. mibchor מִבְחוֺר noun [masculine] choice , in the phrases מִבְחוֺר עִיר choice city 2Kin 3:19 ; בְּרשָׁיו מִבְחוֺר choice for trees 19:23 = בְּרוֺשָׁיו מִבְחַר Isa 37:24 (probably scribal error in both cases for מִבְחַר ).
